description: TypeScript Definition Files - Create index.d.ts TypeScript definition file for the public API, enabling better IDE support and TypeScript integration.
steps: Analyze index.js to understand the public API exports
Analyze ctxman.js to understand CLI exports (if any programmatic API)
Analyze lib/ directory structure to identify all public modules
Create index.d.ts in project root with TypeScript definitions for all public APIs
Add types field to package.json exports: "types": "./index.d.ts"
Ensure definitions cover: TokenAnalyzer class, all exported functions, configuration options
Add JSDoc comments to source files if needed for better type inference
Create lib/*.d.ts files for internal modules if beneficial for IDE support
acceptance_criteria: package.json has types field in exports
TypeScript definitions cover all public APIs
Definitions are syntactically valid (can be tested with tsc --noEmit)
verification: Optionally install typescript and run tsc --noEmit index.d.ts
